```yaml
name: Build CLI Native Archives

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        runtime: [linux-x64, win-x64, osx-x64]
    env:
      DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT: 1
      DOTNET_SKIP_FIRST_TIME_EXPERIENCE: 1
      DOTNET_NOLOGO: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Build solution
        run: dotnet build --configuration Release --no-restore

      - name: Publish CLI for ${{ matrix.runtime }}
        run: |
          dotnet publish src/aspire/aspire.csproj \
            --configuration Release \
            --runtime ${{ matrix.runtime }} \
            --self-contained true \
            --output publish/${{ matrix.runtime }} \
            --no-restore

      - name: Create archive
        run: |
          mkdir -p artifacts
          zip -r artifacts/aspire-${{ matrix.runtime }}.zip publish/${{ matrix.runtime }}

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: aspire-${{ matrix.runtime }}
          path: artifacts/aspire-${{ matrix.runtime }}.zip
```
